title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Renewable Energy And Sustainability
description: Explore sustainable energy solutions and renewable technology with our Special Executive Masters Programme in Renewable Energy and Sustainability.
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Renewable Energy and Sustainability is designed for professionals seeking advanced knowledge in renewable energy technologies and sustainability practices. Through a blend of theory and practical case studies, participants will gain expertise in managing renewable energy projects and implementing sustainable practices. Graduates will be equipped to lead initiatives in renewable energy and contribute to global sustainability goals. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Renewable Energy And Sustainability allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. This programme aims to deliver practical skills in understanding and managing renewable energy solutions and march your business towards sustainability as a business model, supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Renewable Energy and Sustainability aims to empower professionals with cutting-edge expertise in renewable energy technologies and sustainability strategies. The program seeks to inspire innovative thinking, fostering leaders who can drive the transition to sustainable energy systems. Through a multidisciplinary approach, participants will develop the skills to create impactful solutions contributing to a greener, more sustainable future. Course Details: Renewable Energy and Sustainability Management: Explore integrating renewable energy technologies and sustainable practices in organizational management. Operations Management: Analyze efficient strategies for the operational implementation of renewable energy projects and sustainability initiatives. Strategic Management: Develop plans to optimize renewable energy utilization and enhance sustainability performance. Business Management: Apply business management principles to the renewable energy sector, focusing on effective resource allocation and risk management. Global Business Enterprise: Examine the global context of renewable energy markets and sustainability initiatives and their impact on business enterprises. Human Resource Management: Explore human resources' role in fostering a sustainability culture and managing workforce dynamics within renewable energy organizations. Assessment: GP Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in renewable energy and sustainability and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.

modules.title: OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The production and operation functions in businesses are the themes of this course. Evaluation and growth of production and operations management (POM); POM problems; productivity (planning and control) and its measurement; forecasting demand; basic qualitative and quantitative forecasting techniques in major production; inventory control; single and multiple period inventories; statistical quality control; management problems; and case studies.

modules.title: STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This course teaches students to comprehend the concerns and challenges that strategic management managers encounter. It introduces students to concepts, methodological techniques, and instruments that are applicable to the analysis of an organisation's strategic position. Students will learn how to establish and implement strategies and policies, as well as their significant operational implications, in this course.

modules.title: HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The management of human beings in a complex organisation- including human resource planning and development, assessment of future needs, building the personnel function to meet the needs of developing organisations, and developing career paths, training programs, and policies. Resource loyalties, managing personnel to elevate individual contribution and increase quality, and lowering operational costs topics are additionally covered in this course.
